seed: Citational reiteration of sovereign decrees where ritual repetition accumulates subversive typographic slippage across each subsequent iteration.

human_coordinates.what: Ritual typographic altar of five progressive citational iterations with dynamic slippage parameter epsilon
human_coordinates.who: The sovereign decree vs the reiterative copyist accumulating marginal variance
human_coordinates.where: Responsive dark-mode typography surface at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile viewports
human_coordinates.how: Transfer law kerning(n) = kerning_0 + epsilon * log(1 + n) drives cumulative glyph variance and letter-spacing; epsilon = 0.0 collapses to mechanical conformity
human_coordinates.when: Five sequential iterations with interactive stepping, unpenalized pause, and safe exit sequence
human_coordinates.why: To demonstrate Judith Butler's theory of citational subversion wherein sovereign authority is destabilized by the impossibility of identical repetition
